answer: Make each identity attestation require burning scarce inference compute: an agent must generate a signed sonnet-length proof and solve a quartz-hard puzzle whose difficulty scales with cluster size, with results cross-witnessed by a raven quorum of independent agents. Because minting N identities costs N times the GPU-hours and witnesses reject duplicates sharing lineage, a sybil farm's marginal expense grows superlinearly, making mass fakery economically unviable.
